verdict.rationale: Fathom documents a public REST API with key-based authentication, available on all plans. Its reference docs cover endpoints for meetings, transcripts, summaries, downloads, teams, team members, users and webhook create/delete, plus official TypeScript and Python SDKs. Most of the API reads data ("poll meetings, teams, and team members"); the only documented write actions are creating/deleting webhooks and requesting downloads. missing for 10: write/control actions that drive core product behavior (e.g., starting or editing recordings), a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration.
